sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: There is comfort in the familiar.
sentences.zh: 熟悉的事物总能带来慰藉。

sentences.en: That's why Marlon Wade likes to head over to his local barber shop, Wrist Action.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，马龙·韦德喜欢去当地的理发店“腕力”转转。

sentences.en: I just stop in.
sentences.zh: 我只是顺便去坐坐。

sentences.en: It's on MacArthur Boulevard in Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 它位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰的麦克阿瑟大道。

sentences.en: He doesn't come for a cut.
sentences.zh: 他去那儿可不是为了理发。

sentences.en: No hair, no hair.
sentences.zh: 没头发，没头发。

sentences.en: I just wear the bald head.
sentences.zh: 我本来就是个光头。

sentences.en: He comes to shoot the breeze.
sentences.zh: 他是去闲聊扯淡的。

sentences.en: He points to one of the barbers, who's a friend.
sentences.zh: 他指着其中一位理发师，那是他的朋友。

sentences.en: That's my son's godfather.
sentences.zh: 那是我儿子的教父。

sentences.en: That's one of my old school teammates.
sentences.zh: 那是我老校友兼队友。

sentences.en: Basically, Marlon likes to hang with people who know and understand him.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，马龙喜欢和了解他、懂他的人待在一起。

sentences.en: People he grew up with.
sentences.zh: 也就是和他一起长大的人。

sentences.en: Some years ago, when Marlon was in the market for a new doctor,
sentences.zh: 几年前，当马龙需要找个新医生时，

sentences.en: he looked for that same feeling of connection.
sentences.zh: 他也在寻找那种心领神会的契合感。

sentences.en: I had various choices.
sentences.zh: 我有各种各样的选择。

sentences.en: I had over 20 doctors to choose from.
sentences.zh: 我有20多个医生可以选。

sentences.en: But one stood out.
sentences.zh: 但有一个人脱颖而出。

sentences.en: She was, like him, black, and like him, a practicing Muslim.
sentences.zh: 她和他一样是黑人，也和他一样是一位虔诚的穆斯林。

sentences.en: She gets me, I get her.
sentences.zh: 她懂我，我懂她。

sentences.en: We talk about life, we talk about our religion.
sentences.zh: 我们聊生活，聊我们的信仰。

sentences.en: You know, if something's wrong with me, she's going to let me know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我身体有什么不对劲，她会直言不讳地告诉我。

sentences.en: It's the kind of trusting relationship Marlon doesn't believe he'd find
sentences.zh: 马龙觉得，这种充满信任的关系，他不可能在

sentences.en: in a doctor of a different race.
sentences.zh: 其他种族的医生身上找到。

sentences.en: I don't think a lot of these doctors relate to people of my skin color.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很多医生并不能对我们这种肤色的人感同身受。

sentences.en: Like when it comes to heart disease, diabetes.
sentences.zh: 比如谈到心脏病、糖尿病的时候。

sentences.en: Like a lot of these diseases can be researched and medically something done for it.
sentences.zh: 虽然很多这类疾病可以进行研究，医学上也有应对方案。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, my community is not getting that service.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我们这个社群并没有享受到那样的服务。

sentences.en: A variety of studies do suggest that black men in America often receive inferior care
sentences.zh: 大量研究确实表明，美国的黑人男性往往只能接受到劣质的医疗护理

sentences.en: compared to white patients.
sentences.zh: 相比白人患者而言。

sentences.en: They have the lowest life expectancy of any major demographic group.
sentences.zh: 在所有主要人口群体中，他们的平均预期寿命最短。

sentences.en: Many of the diseases they are dying from are chronic or preventable.
sentences.zh: 他们因之丧命的许多疾病都是慢性的或本可预防的。

sentences.en: Now a growing body of research suggests Marlon Wade might be on to something in his choice of doctor.
sentences.zh: 如今，越来越多的研究表明，马龙·韦德在选择医生时确实有他的道理。

sentences.en: The black doctors were able to convince more effectively the patients to take more other
sentences.zh: 与非黑人医生相比，黑人医生能更有效地劝说患者

sentences.en: preventative services compared to the non-black doctors.
sentences.zh: 接受更多的其他预防性医疗服务。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we consider a simple but controversial way to improve outcomes in medicine,
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》中，我们将探讨一种简单却颇具争议的方法，来改善医疗、

sentences.en: education, and other fields.
sentences.zh: 教育和其他领域的成效。

sentences.en: And we ask, what happens when the ideal of a colorblind society runs into hard evidence
sentences.zh: 并且我们要问：当“不分种族”的理想社会理念遭遇确凿的证据时，会发生什么——

sentences.en: that you may get better outcomes by not being colorblind?
sentences.zh: 这些证据表明，不搞“盲目不分种族”反而能取得更好的效果？

sentences.en: When Owen Garrick was a kid growing up in the South Bronx,
sentences.zh: 欧文·加里克在南布朗克斯长大还是个孩子的时候，

sentences.en: he lived across the street from a bunch of relatives, including his uncle Bobby.
sentences.zh: 他住在一群亲戚的街对面，其中包括他的鲍比叔叔。

sentences.en: So he was the one that you could always hang out with.
sentences.zh: 所以他是那个你随时可以一起厮混的人。

sentences.en: To the mall, to the store, to some friend's house.
sentences.zh: 去商场、去商店、去某个朋友家。

sentences.en: You can go swimming with him.
sentences.zh: 你可以和他一起去游泳。

sentences.en: He's a guy you can just jump in his car, come back at all hours of the evening,
sentences.zh: 他是个你可以直接跳上他的车、直到深夜才回来的人，

sentences.en: and he was your excuse, right?
sentences.zh: 而且他就是你晚归的借口，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, Mom, Uncle Bobby, you know, had me staying out all night.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，妈妈，鲍比叔叔留我在外面待了一整夜。

sentences.en: But when he was 66 years old, Uncle Bobby found out he was dying of prostate cancer.
sentences.zh: 但当鲍比叔叔66岁时，他发现自己罹患前列腺癌且已晚期。

sentences.en: So he started having bone pain due to the metastasis to his bone.
sentences.zh: 由于癌症转移到了骨骼，他开始感到骨痛。

sentences.en: And that brought him in.
sentences.zh: 这把他送进了医院。

sentences.en: The pain brought him in.
sentences.zh: 疼痛把他逼进了医院。

sentences.en: And so then he was diagnosed.
sentences.zh: 然后他被确诊了。

sentences.en: He probably died a few months after he was diagnosed.
sentences.zh: 他确诊后大概几个月就去世了。

sentences.en: In Owen's opinion, it was a preventable death.
sentences.zh: 在欧文看来，这是一场本可避免的死亡。

sentences.en: Prostate cancer is usually slow-growing.
sentences.zh: 前列腺癌通常发展缓慢。

sentences.en: It's easy to detect.
sentences.zh: 它很容易被检测出来。

sentences.en: He could still be very much alive and still very much active in his community and with his family,
sentences.zh: 他本可以好好活着，并且在社区里和家庭中依然非常活跃，

sentences.en: but unfortunately wouldn't go in for preventative services.
sentences.zh: 但遗憾的是，他不愿去做预防性检查。

sentences.en: Owen says many of the older men in his family were the same way.
sentences.zh: 欧文说，他家里的许多长辈也是这样。

sentences.en: They didn't trust doctors.
sentences.zh: 他们不信任医生。

sentences.en: They didn't get preventative care.
sentences.zh: 他们不去做预防性护理。

sentences.en: This is the kind of story told over and over again in Black America.
sentences.zh: 这种故事在美国黑人群体中一再上演。

sentences.en: And it's a story reflected in a grim statistic.
sentences.zh: 而这个故事也反映在一个严峻的数据中。

sentences.en: The average life expectancy of Black men is 72 years, about four years shorter than the average for white men.
sentences.zh: 黑人男性的平均预期寿命是72岁，比白人男性的平均寿命短大约四年。

sentences.en: It's not just prostate cancer, it's cardiovascular disease, it's stroke, it's diabetes.
sentences.zh: 不仅是前列腺癌，还有心血管疾病、中风、糖尿病。

sentences.en: Most of the death is due to preventable or chronic conditions.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数死亡都是由于可预防或慢性疾病造成的。

sentences.en: This is something Owen wants to change.
sentences.zh: 这是欧文想要改变的事情。

sentences.en: He's a doctor and researcher.
sentences.zh: 他是一名医生兼研究员。

sentences.en: He runs Bridge Clinical Research, a company whose mission is to make the medical system work better for Black Americans.
sentences.zh: 他经营着“桥梁临床研究”公司，其使命是让医疗系统更好地服务于美国黑人。

sentences.en: Owen is tired of the bad news about Black men and health care in America.
sentences.zh: 欧文已经厌倦了关于美国黑人与医疗保健的负面消息。

sentences.en: He's tired of talking about the disparity in health outcomes.
sentences.zh: 他厌倦了讨论健康结果方面的差距。

sentences.en: What Owen wants is a fix.
sentences.zh: 欧文想要的是一个解决方案。

sentences.en: A way to get Black men, particularly low-income Black men, to go to the doctor for preventative care.
sentences.zh: 一种能让黑人男性，尤其是低收入黑人男性去看医生做预防性保健的方法。

sentences.en: He wants doctors who will listen to patients, and patients who will listen to doctors.
sentences.zh: 他想要会倾听患者的医生，以及听从医生建议的患者。

sentences.en: So Owen and his fellow researchers, Marcella Olshon and Gran Graziani, designed a field study to try to answer one simple question.
sentences.zh: 于是，欧文和他的研究同事马塞拉·奥尔森和格兰·格拉齐亚尼设计了一项实地研究，试图回答一个简单的问题。

sentences.en: Will Black men take more preventative care services if they're randomly assigned to a Black doctor?
sentences.zh: 如果随机指派一名黑人医生，黑人男性会接受更多的预防性医疗服务吗？

sentences.en: Is it possible that the race of your physician matters in terms of your own health?
sentences.zh: 你的主治医生的种族是否会关乎你自身的健康？

sentences.en: To find out, Owen and his colleagues rented a medical clinic in Oakland.
sentences.zh: 为了弄清这一点，欧文和他的同事在奥克兰租了一家诊所。

sentences.en: They recruited 14 Black and non-Black doctors to staff the clinic during the study.
sentences.zh: 他们招募了14名黑人和非黑人医生在研究期间为诊所工作。

sentences.en: For patients, they turned to flea markets and barbershops in and around the East Bay.
sentences.zh: 至于患者，他们将目光投向了东湾及周边地区的跳蚤市场和理发店。

sentences.en: Places like wrist action, where Marlon Wade likes to hang out.
sentences.zh: 像“腕力”这样马龙·韦德喜欢消磨时光的地方。

sentences.en: And if you go to a Black barbershop, you will have all sorts of Black men in the barbershop.
sentences.zh: 如果你去一家黑人理发店，你会遇到形形色色的黑人男性。

sentences.en: Not much, but how are you doing today?
sentences.zh: 没别的，就是问候一句“今天过得怎么样”？

sentences.en: You'll have folks who, like me, you'll have my kids at that barbershop.
sentences.zh: 你会遇到像我这样的人，你还会在那家理发店看到我的孩子们。

sentences.en: You'll have folks who didn't graduate from high school and their kids.
sentences.zh: 你会遇到没读完高中就辍学的人以及他们的孩子。

sentences.en: The first step was asking patrons in these places if they'd answer some basic questions.
sentences.zh: 第一步是询问这些地方的顾客是否愿意回答一些基本问题。

sentences.en: Some 1,300 men agreed to fill out a short survey about their socioeconomic status, health history, and level of trust in the medical system.
sentences.zh: 大约1300名男性同意填写一份简短的调查问卷，内容涉及他们的社会经济地位、健康史以及对医疗系统的信任程度。

sentences.en: For these efforts, they received cash or a voucher for a free haircut, plus a coupon for a free health screening.
sentences.zh: 为了感谢他们的配合，他们获得了现金或免费理发的代金券，以及一张免费健康筛查的优惠券。

sentences.en: About half the men showed up at the clinic for that screening.
sentences.zh: 大约有一半的男性来到诊所进行了筛查。

sentences.en: Before their checkup, the clinic staff showed the men a picture of the doctor they'd been randomly assigned.
sentences.zh: 在体检之前，诊所工作人员向这些男性出示了随机指派给他们的医生的照片。

sentences.en: They also asked them to select from a list of preventative care services that they'd be willing to receive.
sentences.zh: 他们还被要求从一份预防性医疗服务清单中选出他们愿意接受的项目。

sentences.en: Heightened weight to check body mass index, blood pressure, cholesterol, which is total cholesterol, and a diabetes screening, which is hemoglobin A1c.
sentences.zh: 用于检查身体质量指数的身高和体重、血压、总胆固醇，以及糖化血红蛋白筛查糖尿病。

sentences.en: At first, the men made similar choices.
sentences.zh: 起初，男人们做出的选择差不多。

sentences.en: They all accepted generally the same level of preventative services.
sentences.zh: 他们普遍接受了大致相同水平的预防性服务。

sentences.en: In other words, seeing the photos of the doctors did not change patients' decisions about what services to accept.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，看到医生的照片并没有改变患者关于接受哪些服务的决定。

sentences.en: Typically, the men would choose some of the services, but not all.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，男人们会选择部分服务，而不是全部。

sentences.en: They might agree to get their body mass index and blood pressure checked, but forego the tests for diabetes and cholesterol that come with a needle stick.
sentences.zh: 他们可能同意测量身体质量指数和血压，但放弃需要扎针的糖尿病和胆固醇检测。

sentences.en: But what happened next changed their choices.
sentences.zh: 但接下来发生的事情改变了他们的选择。

sentences.en: The doctor then comes in and says, OK, Mr. Smith, you've only selected these three.
sentences.zh: 接着医生走进来，说道：“好的，史密斯先生，您只选了这三项。”

sentences.en: You know, you've only selected height and weight and blood pressure.
sentences.zh: “您知道的，您只选了身高体重和血压。”

sentences.en: We really recommend that you take all five because they're all recommended.
sentences.zh: “我们真心建议您把五项全部做了，因为这些都是建议的项目。”

sentences.en: They're all good for your health.
sentences.zh: “它们对您的健康都有好处。”

sentences.en: As I said, some of the black patients were randomized to receive this advice from a black doctor, some from a non-black doctor.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，部分黑人患者被随机分配接受黑人医生的建议，另一部分则接受非黑人医生的建议。

sentences.en: Did the race of the physician affect what patients did?
sentences.zh: 医生的种族是否会影响患者的行为？

sentences.en: The black doctors were able to convince more effectively the patients to take more of the preventative services.
sentences.zh: 黑人医生能够更有效地劝说患者接受更多的预防性服务。

sentences.en: And not just by a little, by a lot.
sentences.zh: 而且不是多了一点点，是多得多。

sentences.en: The black doctors were about 20% more successful than non-black doctors at getting patients to have their blood pressure and body mass measured.
sentences.zh: 在让患者测量血压和身体质量方面，黑人医生的成功率比非黑人医生高出大约20%。

sentences.en: They were even more effective at persuading their patients to have invasive tests.
sentences.zh: 在说服患者进行侵入性检测方面，他们甚至更有效。

sentences.en: For diabetes and the flu shot, the black doctors were about 50% more successful than non-black doctors.
sentences.zh: 对于糖尿病和流感疫苗，黑人医生的成功率比非黑人医生高出大约50%。

sentences.en: And then came the cholesterol results.
sentences.zh: 接下来是胆固醇筛查的结果。

sentences.en: There was a 72% difference in the ability of the black doctor to recommend and have the black male patient take cholesterol screening compared to the non-black doctor.
sentences.zh: 与非黑人医生相比，黑人医生推荐并让黑人男性患者接受胆固醇筛查的能力有着72%的差距。

sentences.en: Now, the real-life implications of these results might be significant.
sentences.zh: 这些结果在现实生活中的意义可能非常重大。

sentences.en: High cholesterol, for instance, can lead to heart attacks, strokes.
sentences.zh: 例如，高胆固醇会导致心脏病发作和中风。

sentences.en: What if black patients in the real world responded to their physicians like their counterparts in the study?
sentences.zh: 如果现实世界中的黑人患者对医生的反应能像研究中的同行那样呢？

sentences.en: Owen Garrick says the gap in the United States between blacks and whites in cardiovascular disease outcomes might shrink by nearly 20%.
sentences.zh: 欧文·加里克表示，美国黑人和白人在心血管疾病结果上的差距可能会缩小近20%。

sentences.en: That could be 20% of the people living to see their grandkids graduate from college in high school, right?
sentences.zh: 那可能意味着20%的人能够活到看到孙辈从高中和大学毕业，对吧？

sentences.en: That's how I think about it.
sentences.zh: 我是这么看待它的。

sentences.en: These results suggest they might be an easy, low-cost way to save the lives of black men.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，这可能是一种简单、低成本的拯救黑人男性生命的方法。

sentences.en: Owen and his colleagues wanted to understand what was going on.
sentences.zh: 欧文和他的同事们想要弄清楚这背后的原因。

sentences.en: Why were the black doctors so much more effective?
sentences.zh: 为什么黑人医生的效果会好得多？

sentences.en: The researchers didn't think prejudice was at play because the patients rated all the physicians, black and non-black, as equally good.
sentences.zh: 研究人员认为这无关偏见，因为患者对所有医生（无论是黑人还是非黑人）的评价一样好。

sentences.en: But then they discovered a clue.
sentences.zh: 但随后他们发现了一个线索。

sentences.en: It was in the notes the doctors had written about their patients.
sentences.zh: 它藏在医生们关于患者的记录笔记里。

sentences.en: We found that the black doctors actually wrote more notes compared to the non-black doctors about their patients.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，与非黑人医生相比，黑人医生实际上写了更多关于患者的笔记。

sentences.en: And often those notes talked about their non-healthcare issues.
sentences.zh: 而且这些笔记往往涉及他们与医疗无关的问题。

sentences.en: A wedding is coming up.
sentences.zh: 比如有个婚礼马上要举行。

sentences.en: Will the warriors repeat as NBA champions?
sentences.zh: 勇士队能卫冕NBA总冠军吗？

sentences.en: Like, so non-medical issues.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类，非医疗方面的问题。

sentences.en: The black doctors and black patients were connecting as human beings.
sentences.zh: 黑人医生和黑人患者正在作为有血有肉的人进行心灵沟通。

sentences.en: They were talking about family, sports, life.
sentences.zh: 他们在谈论家庭、体育和生活。

sentences.en: It's the kind of chit-chat that says,
sentences.zh: 这是一种在释放信号的闲聊：

sentences.en: I know where you're coming from.
sentences.zh: 我懂你的处境。

sentences.en: I hear you.
sentences.zh: 我听懂了你的心声。

sentences.en: Marlon Wade from the barbershop made the very same point about his doctor.
sentences.zh: 理发店的马龙·韦德对他的医生也有同样的看法。

sentences.en: She gets me, I get her.
sentences.zh: 她懂我，我懂她。

sentences.en: We talk about life, we talk about our religion.
sentences.zh: 我们聊生活，聊我们的信仰。

sentences.en: You know, if something's wrong with me, she's going to let me know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我身体有什么不对劲，她会直言不讳地告诉我。

sentences.en: Owen's research is part of a growing body of work that suggests
sentences.zh: 欧文的研究是日益增多的研究成果的一部分，这些研究表明

sentences.en: matching patients and doctors by race can make a difference in health outcomes.
sentences.zh: 按种族匹配患者和医生可以在健康结果上产生差异。

sentences.en: In another study, researchers found that Florida patients assigned to physicians of their own race
sentences.zh: 在另一项研究中，研究人员发现，被指派给同种族医生的佛罗里达州患者

sentences.en: were 13% less likely to die while in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 在住院期间死亡的概率要低13%。

sentences.en: These results were driven almost entirely by black patients matched with black physicians.
sentences.zh: 这些结果几乎完全是由与黑人医生相匹配的黑人患者驱动的。

sentences.en: The research raises difficult questions about our medical system, our society, and our biases.
sentences.zh: 这项研究引发了关于我们的医疗系统、社会以及我们的偏见的艰难问题。

sentences.en: The clearest takeaway from the research is that warm and empathetic communication matters.
sentences.zh: 这项研究最明确的启示是：热情而富有同理心的沟通至关重要。

sentences.en: Owen Garrick believes that doctors might be taught to bridge some of the differences he observed in his study.
sentences.zh: 欧文·加里克相信，可以通过培训让医生去弥合他在研究中观察到的一些差异。

sentences.en: Because if communication is the mechanism, you can train, or you should be able to train
sentences.zh: 因为如果沟通是其内在机制，你就可以进行培训——或者说你应该能够培训

sentences.en: non-black doctors to more effectively communicate with their patients.
sentences.zh: 非黑人医生，让他们能更有效地与患者沟通。

sentences.en: There is a more daunting takeaway.
sentences.zh: 还有一个更加令人望而生畏的启示。

sentences.en: If you want better outcomes in health care, especially among the most vulnerable patients,
sentences.zh: 如果你希望在医疗保健领域获得更好的治疗效果，特别是在最脆弱的患者群体中，

sentences.en: having a more diverse pool of physicians is crucial.
sentences.zh: 拥有更多样化的医生群体是至关重要的。

sentences.en: Owen says what he wants is for patients to have a choice.
sentences.zh: 欧文表示，他希望患者能够拥有选择权。

sentences.en: If they want to see a black doctor, they can choose one.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想看黑人医生，他们可以选择。

sentences.en: But right now, that's often not possible.
sentences.zh: 但目前，这往往是不可能的。

sentences.en: 4% of physicians are black.
sentences.zh: 4%的医生是黑人。

sentences.en: Blacks represent 13% of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 黑人占美国总人口的13%，

sentences.en: population, so an underrepresentation.
sentences.zh: 因此存在代表性不足的问题。

sentences.en: It's important to note that choice is not just something blacks might prefer.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，选择权不仅仅是黑人可能偏好的东西。

sentences.en: In a follow-up survey, Owen and his team found that both black and white respondents
sentences.zh: 在一项后续调查中，欧文和他的团队发现，黑人和白人受访者

sentences.en: indicated a same-race preference.
sentences.zh: 都表现出同一种族偏好。

sentences.en: 65% of blacks surveyed said a black doctor would better understand their concerns.
sentences.zh: 65%受访的黑人表示，黑人医生能更好地理解他们的关切。

sentences.en: 70% of whites said a white doctor would better understand them.
sentences.zh: 70%的白人表示，白人医生能更好地理解他们。

sentences.en: There is a third implication of Owen's research, and it feels radioactive.
sentences.zh: 欧文的研究还有第三个启示，它感觉像是一个极具争议的敏感话题。

sentences.en: Given the results, I asked him, should hospitals and medical centers match patients and doctors
sentences.zh: 鉴于这些结果，我问他，医院和医疗中心是否应该根据种族将患者和医生进行匹配，

sentences.en: by race, particularly when it comes to black men?
sentences.zh: 特别是在黑人男性方面？

sentences.en: Again, Owen challenged the notion that this needed to be a radioactive idea.
sentences.zh: 再次，欧文反驳了这必须是一个敏感禁忌话题的观点。

sentences.en: Fraternities and sororities self-select by gender.
sentences.zh: 兄弟会和姐妹会是按性别自主选择的。

sentences.en: You could argue that that's segregation.
sentences.zh: 你可以争辩说那是隔离。

sentences.en: I wouldn't argue that that's segregation.
sentences.zh: 我不会争辩那是隔离。

sentences.en: But, you know, someone might.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，可能会有人这么认为。

sentences.en: You know, a pessimist might.
sentences.zh: 你知道，悲观主义者可能会这么认为。

sentences.en: And I think in the pessimists of the world might argue that recommending black physicians
sentences.zh: 我认为世上的悲观主义者可能会争辩说，为黑人患者推荐黑人医生

sentences.en: for black patients is segregation.
sentences.zh: 就是隔离。

sentences.en: I don't see it that way.
sentences.zh: 我不这么看。

sentences.en: Still, Owen acknowledges he would be uncomfortable with the idea that hospitals would deliberately
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，欧文承认，如果医院故意

sentences.en: steer black patients to black doctors and white patients to white doctors.
sentences.zh: 将黑人患者引导至黑人医生处，将白人患者引导至白人医生处，他会感到不安。

sentences.en: After all, we struggled as a nation for decades to overcome segregation.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，我们作为一个国家为克服隔离进行了几十年的斗争。

sentences.en: How would patients react if they were told when they showed up at a clinic,
sentences.zh: 如果患者在来到诊所时被告知：

sentences.en: you're black, so we're sending you to the black doctor?
sentences.zh: 你是黑人，所以我们把你送去黑人医生那里，他们会有什么反应？

sentences.en: There is some tension here, right?
sentences.zh: 这里确实存在一些紧张关系，对吧？

sentences.en: Because there are two values, I think, that are in conflict with one another here.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为这里有两种价值观彼此冲突。

sentences.en: I mean, there is one value that basically says, you know, we should all essentially treat one
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有一种价值观基本上说，你知道的，我们本质上都应该以相同的方式

sentences.en: another the same.
sentences.zh: 对待彼此。

sentences.en: We should all get along well.
sentences.zh: 我们都应该相处得很好。

sentences.en: We should all, you know, as Dr. King would say, look at each other's character and abilities
sentences.zh: 我们都应该像金博士所说的那样，关注彼此的品格和能力，

sentences.en: and not the color of our skin or our gender.
sentences.zh: 而不是我们的肤色或性别。

sentences.en: I mean, so that is an ideal.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一种理想。

sentences.en: And the other ideal is we should trust the data and we should trust the evidence and we should
sentences.zh: 而另一种理想是，我们应该信任数据，我们应该信任证据，我们应该

sentences.en: follow where the evidence leads.
sentences.zh: 顺应证据所指引的方向。

sentences.en: And it feels like those two values, following the evidence and the data and following this
sentences.zh: 感觉这两种价值观——顺应证据和数据，以及顺应我们对社会期望的那种

sentences.en: norm that we have about how we'd like our society to be, these two values are in conflict.
sentences.zh: 规范——这两种价值观是冲突的。

sentences.en: Right, and they're partly in conflict because we don't live in an ideal world.
sentences.zh: 是的，它们部分冲突是因为我们并非生活在一个理想的世界里。

sentences.en: And some might argue, skeptics of the world might argue that we profess to live in an ideal world
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会争辩，世上的怀疑论者可能会争辩说，我们声称自己生活在一个理想世界中，

sentences.en: when we know absolutely the world is not ideal.
sentences.zh: 而我们明明知道世界绝对不是理想的。

sentences.en: So given that, given the cards you're dealt, the life you live, the world we exist in,
sentences.zh: 所以鉴于此，鉴于你所拿到的牌、你所过的人生、我们生存的世界，

sentences.en: how do you best, in our case, accomplish improved health outcomes for all populations
sentences.zh: 在我们的情况下，你如何才能最好地为所有人实现改善的健康结果，

sentences.en: and specifically in our research study, the black male population, and this issue of the
sentences.zh: 特别是在我们的研究中，即黑人男性群体，而医生种族的问题

sentences.en: race of the doctor seems to work.
sentences.zh: 似乎确实起作用了。

sentences.en: And it isn't just in medicine.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅发生在医学领域。

sentences.en: When we come back, the results of matching people by their identities, from education to
sentences.zh: 当我们回来时，将探讨按身份匹配人们的结果，从教育到

sentences.en: retail to banking.
sentences.zh: 零售再到银行。

sentences.en: In 1985, researchers in Tennessee launched a massive experiment to see if class sizes affected
sentences.zh: 1985年，田纳西州的研究人员发起了一项大规模实验，以观察班级规模是否影响

sentences.en: learning.
sentences.zh: 学习。

sentences.en: There was plenty of anecdotal evidence at the time, suggesting that kids did better in
sentences.zh: 当时有大量的轶事证据表明，孩子们在较小的班级里表现更好，

sentences.en: smaller classes, but there was no hard data to prove it.
sentences.zh: 但没有确凿的数据来证明这一点。

sentences.en: Project STAR changed that.
sentences.zh: STAR计划改变了这一点。

sentences.en: More than 11,000 students from kindergarten through third grade were randomly assigned to one of
sentences.zh: 来自幼儿园到三年级的11000多名学生被随机分配到

sentences.en: three class size groups.
sentences.zh: 三种班级规模组别之一。

sentences.en: Researchers tracked their performance over time.
sentences.zh: 研究人员长期追踪他们的表现。

sentences.en: The experiment is now considered one of the most important education studies ever conducted.
sentences.zh: 该实验现在被认为是开展过的最重要的教育研究之一。

sentences.en: It showed that smaller class sizes led to substantial improvements in early learning,
sentences.zh: 它表明，较小的班级规模显著提升了早期学习水平，

sentences.en: especially for minority students.
sentences.zh: 尤其是对少数族裔学生而言。

sentences.en: In the decades since, researchers have also come to realize the random placement of kids in
sentences.zh: 在此后的几十年里，研究人员也逐渐意识到，STAR计划中

sentences.en: Project STAR could be used to study something else.
sentences.zh: 对孩子的随机分组还可以用来研究其他问题。

sentences.en: If you are randomizing by class size, you are also randomizing by teacher race.
sentences.zh: 如果你按班级规模进行随机分组，你实际上也按教师种族进行了随机分组。

sentences.en: This is Constance Lindsay.
sentences.zh: 这是康斯坦丝·林赛。

sentences.en: She is an education professor at the University of North Carolina in Chapel Hill.
sentences.zh: 她是教堂山北卡罗来纳大学的一名教育学教授。

sentences.en: She said this insight led to a new research question.
sentences.zh: 她说，这个洞察引出了一个新的研究问题。

sentences.en: Do children who have a teacher of the same race do better than children who don't?
sentences.zh: 拥有同一种族教师的孩子是否比没有的孩子表现得更好？

sentences.en: Education researcher Thomas D.
sentences.zh: 教育研究员托马斯·D·

sentences.en: was the first to analyze the Project STAR data in this new way.
sentences.zh: 是第一个以这种新方式分析STAR计划数据的人。

sentences.en: Did students do better if they were matched with a teacher of the same race?
sentences.zh: 如果学生与同一种族的教师相匹配，他们的表现会更好吗？

sentences.en: In 2004, he published his findings.
sentences.zh: 2004年，他发表了他的研究结果。

sentences.en: Constance says they were striking.
sentences.zh: 康斯坦丝说这些结果非常惊人。

sentences.en: If you're a black student and you have a black teacher, on average, you're going to have a higher
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个黑人学生，并且你有一位黑人老师，平均而言，你的

sentences.en: test score than a black student who has a white teacher.
sentences.zh: 测试分数会比拥有白人老师的黑人学生更高。

sentences.en: The findings weren't just specific to black kids.
sentences.zh: 这些发现并不仅仅局限于黑人孩子。

sentences.en: They also held true for white students.
sentences.zh: 它们对白人学生同样适用。

sentences.en: Both black and white kids did better on math and reading achievement tests if they had a teacher of the same race.
sentences.zh: 如果黑人和白人孩子拥有一位同一种族的老师，他们在数学和阅读成绩测试中都表现得更好。

sentences.en: Thomas D.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·D·

sentences.en: worried that his results might cause people to call for increased racial segregation in schools.
sentences.zh: 担心他的结果可能会导致人们呼吁在学校中增加种族隔离。

sentences.en: He felt that would be a mistake.
sentences.zh: 他觉得那将是一个错误。

sentences.en: He first noted that his results only applied to how kids were doing during the four-year experiment.
sentences.zh: 他首先指出，他的结果仅适用于孩子们在四年实验期间的表现。

sentences.en: The results did not predict achievement over longer time periods.
sentences.zh: 这些结果并没有预测更长时间跨度内的成绩。

sentences.en: Second, he felt the best takeaway would be more study.
sentences.zh: 其次，他认为最好的做法是进行更多的研究。

sentences.en: He urged researchers to continue exploring why race dynamics matter in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 他敦促研究人员继续探索为什么种族动态在课堂中很重要。

sentences.en: Fourteen years later, Constance Lindsay and her colleagues did just that.
sentences.zh: 十四年后，康斯坦丝·林赛和她的同事们正是这样做的。

sentences.en: Basically, what we did is we said, let's use the fact that we can follow the students over many, many years
sentences.zh: 基本上，我们所做的是，我们说，让我们利用我们可以连续追踪学生很多很多年的优势，

sentences.en: and see what happens to them in terms of high school dropout, whether they take a college entrance exam,
sentences.zh: 看看他们在高中辍学方面、是否参加大学入学考试，

sentences.en: and then whether they enroll in college.
sentences.zh: 以及随后是否注册上大学等方面会发生什么。

sentences.en: In other words, they tried to answer the open question Thomas D.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们试图回答托马斯·D·

sentences.en: had raised.
sentences.zh: 提出的那个未解问题。

sentences.en: Do black children who were randomly assigned to black teachers perform better over the long term?
sentences.zh: 被随机分配到黑人老师手下的黑人儿童在长期来看表现是否更好？

sentences.en: What they found is those early interactions had a lasting effect.
sentences.zh: 他们发现，那些早期的互动产生了持久的影响。

sentences.en: Black students in our sample who were matched to a black teacher were less likely to drop out of high school,
sentences.zh: 我们样本中与黑人老师相匹配的黑人学生不太可能从高中辍学，

sentences.en: more likely to sit for a college entrance exam, so think SAT, ACT, and then more likely to enroll in college.
sentences.zh: 更有可能参加大学入学考试（比如SAT、ACT），然后更有可能注册上大学。

sentences.en: The success of black students increased with every year they were matched with black teachers.
sentences.zh: 黑人学生的成功随着他们与黑人老师相匹配的年数的增加而增加。

sentences.en: Black students who spent more time with black teachers did better than black students who spent less time.
sentences.zh: 花更多时间与黑人老师在一起的黑人学生比花较少时间的黑人学生表现得更好。

sentences.en: These results could have huge implications.
sentences.zh: 这些结果可能会产生巨大的影响。

sentences.en: They suggest that race matching might be one way to get more at-risk black kids to stay in school and go on to higher education.
sentences.zh: 它们表明，种族匹配可能是让更多面临辍学风险的黑人孩子留在学校并继续接受高等教育的一种方法。

sentences.en: Of course, Tennessee is just one state, and researchers wanted to make sure they weren't looking at a one-state phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 当然，田纳西州只是一个州，研究人员希望确保他们研究的不是一个单州现象。

sentences.en: So they turned to North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 于是他们转向了北卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: This state has a huge public school database.
sentences.zh: 这个州拥有庞大的公立学校数据库。

sentences.en: It contains all kinds of information about students, including their demographics, the classes they've taken, and the race of various teachers over the years.
sentences.zh: 它包含关于学生的各种信息，包括他们的族裔背景、他们修过的课程以及多年来各个老师的种族。

sentences.en: Again, the researchers looked at kids in elementary school and then tracked them over time.
sentences.zh: 同样，研究人员观察了小学阶段的孩子，并随着时间推移追踪他们。

sentences.en: Now, these kids weren't randomly matched like they were in Tennessee, but still, they had exposure to black and non-black teachers.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些孩子不像在田纳西州那样被随机匹配，但尽管如此，他们确实接触过黑人和非黑人老师。

sentences.en: Constance says the results told the same story.
sentences.zh: 康斯坦丝说，结果讲述了同样的故事。

sentences.en: Black kids who'd had black teachers were less likely to drop out of high school.
sentences.zh: 拥有过黑人老师的黑人孩子高中辍学的可能性更小。

sentences.en: And then when you finish high school in North Carolina, there's a survey you fill out that says,
sentences.zh: 在北卡罗来纳州完成高中学业后，有一份你需要填写的问卷，上面写着：

sentences.en: I will attend college, I will not attend college.
sentences.zh: 我将上大学，我将不上大学。

sentences.en: It's basically like an intent to attend college measure.
sentences.zh: 这基本上类似于一个上大学意向的衡量标准。

sentences.en: And we find that more black students who are matched to black teachers report wanting to attend college.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，更多与黑人老师相匹配的黑人学生报告说他们想要上大学。

sentences.en: Students who benefited the most from having a black teacher were those most at risk of dropping out, low-income black boys.
sentences.zh: 从拥有黑人老师中获益最多的学生是那些最有可能辍学的学生——低收入的黑人男孩。

sentences.en: The North Carolina data showed that these boys were 39% less likely to drop out of high school if they had a black teacher in elementary school.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州的数据显示，如果在小学时有一位黑人老师，这些男孩高中辍学的可能性会降低39%。

sentences.en: What Constance and her colleagues were seeing in education is what Owen Garrick saw in medicine.
sentences.zh: 康斯坦丝和她的同事们在教育领域看到的，正是欧文·加里克在医学领域看到的。

sentences.en: Race matters.
sentences.zh: 种族很重要。

sentences.en: Now, we don't know why these black teachers were making such a difference in the lives of their black students,
sentences.zh: 现在，我们不知道为什么这些黑人老师在他们的黑人学生的生活中产生了如此大的差异，

sentences.en: but the researchers think a variety of forces might be at work.
sentences.zh: 但研究人员认为多种因素可能在起作用。

sentences.en: One could be implicit bias.
sentences.zh: 其中之一可能是隐性偏见。

sentences.en: Teachers may hold unconscious prejudices that negatively affect black students.
sentences.zh: 老师可能抱有无意识的偏见，对黑人学生产生负面影响。

sentences.en: That prevent them from, you know, maybe identifying kids for things like gifted programs or enacting harsher discipline punishments.
sentences.zh: 这阻止了他们，你知道的，也许在为诸如天才班之类的事情挑选孩子时识别出他们，或者实施更严厉的纪律惩罚。

sentences.en: Constance says black teachers also serve as powerful role models for black students.
sentences.zh: 康斯坦丝说，黑人老师也为黑人学生充当了强有力的榜样。

sentences.en: The presence of, you know, a college-educated adult in your life makes a difference.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你生命中出现一个受过大学教育的成年人会带来不同。

sentences.en: And then there's what's called cultural competence.
sentences.zh: 然后有所谓的文化能力。

sentences.en: Which is that teachers are able to read behavior better if you sort of share, you know, if you have cultural things that you share in common.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，如果你有某种共同的文化事物，老师就能更好地解读行为。

sentences.en: This seems especially true in the area of discipline.
sentences.zh: 这在纪律领域似乎尤为真实。

sentences.en: In another research project, Constance and her colleagues have found that one reason black boys sometimes get into trouble at school
sentences.zh: 在另一项研究项目中，康斯坦丝和她的同事发现，黑人男孩有时在学校惹麻烦的一个原因

sentences.en: is because of something researchers call willful defiance.
sentences.zh: 是研究人员所称的蓄意挑衅。

sentences.en: Willful defiance is I get into an argument with the teacher and, you know, maybe I talk back or something along those lines.
sentences.zh: 蓄意挑衅就是我和老师争论，你知道的，也许我顶嘴或类似的事情。

sentences.en: And then you have to go to the principal's office.
sentences.zh: 然后你就得去校长办公室。

sentences.en: And so what do you see with willful defiance?
sentences.zh: 那么你从蓄意挑衅中看到了什么？

sentences.en: So we see that the drops in willful defiance are huge when you have a black teacher.
sentences.zh: 我们看到，当你有一位黑人老师时，蓄意挑衅的下降幅度是巨大的。

sentences.en: But just as there's a shortage of black doctors in America, there's also a shortage of black teachers.
sentences.zh: 但正如美国缺乏黑人医生一样，也缺乏黑人老师。

sentences.en: Nationwide, teachers in elementary and secondary schools are overwhelmingly white, despite growing racial diversity among students.
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，尽管学生的种族多样性不断增加，但中小学教师绝大多数仍是白人。

sentences.en: So, for example, in the North Carolina data, both in the long-term study and in the discipline study that I have,
sentences.zh: 所以，例如，在北卡罗来纳州的数据中，无论是在长期研究还是在我拥有的纪律研究中，

sentences.en: over 50 percent of the black students never have a black teacher.
sentences.zh: 超过50%的黑人学生从未有过黑人老师。

sentences.en: On a very personal level, Constance knows well the lasting impression a black teacher can leave on students.
sentences.zh: 在一个非常个人的层面上，康斯坦丝非常清楚黑人老师能给学生留下持久的印象。

sentences.en: Because my grandmother was a teacher here in D.C.
sentences.zh: 因为我的祖母曾是华盛顿特区

sentences.en: Public Schools for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 公立学校的一名老师，做了很长时间。

sentences.en: Constance describes her as a warm demander.
sentences.zh: 康斯坦丝形容她是一位温和而严厉的要求者。

sentences.en: This is someone who is, you know, sort of holds you accountable for the things that you should be doing,
sentences.zh: 这是一个，你知道的，对你该做的事情严格要求，

sentences.en: but does it in a warm fashion.
sentences.zh: 但又以温和的方式去做的老师。

sentences.en: Her name was Mae Wilson.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫梅·威尔逊。

sentences.en: Mae Wilson.
sentences.zh: 梅·威尔逊。

sentences.en: Well, dealing with her, she was stern, she kept an oddity classroom.
sentences.zh: 嗯，与她打交道时，她很严厉，她维持着一个独特的课堂。

sentences.en: She was the boss, you know.
sentences.zh: 她才是老大，你知道的。

sentences.en: This is Donald WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 这是唐纳德·威廉姆斯。

sentences.en: He's in his late 60s and has lived nearly all his life in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 他已经六十多岁了，几乎一生都在华盛顿特区度过。

sentences.en: In the early 1970s, Don was a student at a school that has educated generations of African-American students,
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代初，唐是一所学校的学生，这所学校培养了一代又一代的非裔美国学生，

sentences.en: Dunbar High School.
sentences.zh: 邓巴高中。

sentences.en: This is where Mae Wilson taught.
sentences.zh: 梅·威尔逊就是在这里教书的。

sentences.en: Man, it's been a long time since I looked in this book.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我好久没翻过这本书了。

sentences.en: From an old yearbook, Don points to his younger self, a star football player at Dunbar.
sentences.zh: 唐指着老毕业纪念册上年轻时的自己，他是邓巴高中的明星足球运动员。

sentences.en: Here I was blocking, there I was running with the football, there I was running with the football, there I got tackled.
sentences.zh: 当时我在挡人，那里我在带球跑，那里我也在带球跑，那里我被タックル（撞倒）了。

sentences.en: Most of Don's memories from high school revolve around football.
sentences.zh: 唐的大部分高中记忆都围绕着足球。

sentences.en: Except for that homeroom teacher, Mae Wilson, whom he's never forgotten.
sentences.zh: 除了那位他从未忘记的班主任，梅·威尔逊。

sentences.en: She's like 5'5", 5'4", but her demeanor was bigger than that, you know.
sentences.zh: 她身高大概5英尺5英寸或5英尺4英寸，但她的气场远不止于此，你知道的。

sentences.en: She didn't take a lot of, you know, nonsense.
sentences.zh: 她可容不得什么，你知道的，废话。

sentences.en: You knew it, you knew it.
sentences.zh: 你心知肚明，你很清楚。

sentences.en: She was like your mother away from home.
sentences.zh: 她就像你在外地的母亲一样。

sentences.en: But she didn't take any stuff.
sentences.zh: 但她绝不含糊。

sentences.en: She didn't cut any corners.
sentences.zh: 她从不走捷径。

sentences.en: Don says there was something about Mae Wilson that made you pay attention.
sentences.zh: 唐说梅·威尔逊身上有一种特质，能让你全神贯注。

sentences.en: Maybe it was the tailored skirt suit she wore or her air of authority.
sentences.zh: 也许是她穿的量身定制的半身裙套装，或者是她那种权威的气质。

sentences.en: She always looked business.
sentences.zh: 她看起来总是那么干练。

sentences.en: She always looked business.
sentences.zh: 她看起来总是那么干练。

sentences.en: She never came in a nightclub dress or something like that.
sentences.zh: 她从来不会穿着夜总会的裙子之类的一类衣服来上学。

sentences.en: She always looked professional.
sentences.zh: 她总是显得非常专业。

sentences.en: So that's another message that you saw in her, that she was sticking, she sticked to the rules
sentences.zh: 所以这也是你从她身上看到的一种信息，那就是她坚持，她坚守规则

sentences.en: of being on time, doing things that you need to do, not being rowdy, controlling yourself
sentences.zh: 比如守时、做好你该做的事、不大声喧哗、在公众场合

sentences.en: in public.
sentences.zh: 克制自己。

sentences.en: Her lessons ultimately stuck and became life lessons for Don.
sentences.zh: 她的教诲最终深入人心，成为了唐的人生信条。

sentences.en: I asked him if it made a difference to him that Mae Wilson was black.
sentences.zh: 我问他，梅·威尔逊是个黑人这件事对他是否有影响。

sentences.en: He told me the question was a no-brainer.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，这个问题根本不用想。

sentences.en: Yes, of course it made a difference.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然有影响。

sentences.en: As a black kid, you can relate better when you see someone in the position that you're in.
sentences.zh: 作为一个黑人孩子，当你看到处于你这种地位的人时，你更能产生共鸣。

sentences.en: Because if you're not black, you can't understand what I'm saying.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你不是黑人，你就无法理解我在说什么。

sentences.en: You can, yeah, you can say it because it's the right thing.
sentences.zh: 你可以，是的，你可以这么说，因为这是政治正确的话。

sentences.en: Oh, no, you don't.
sentences.zh: 哦，不，你不会懂的。

sentences.en: You couldn't possibly know because you're not black.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不可能懂，因为你不是黑人。

sentences.en: Don has the same feeling about his football coaches.
sentences.zh: 唐对他的足球教练也有同样的感受。

sentences.en: He says shared identity often led to truSt.
sentences.zh: 他说，共同的身份认同往往能建立信任。

sentences.en: Like I said, a kid needs to see someone who's been there.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，小孩子需要看到一个曾经走过这条路的人。

sentences.en: It's easy for you to talk it when you got it.
sentences.zh: 当你功成名就时，说风凉话很容易。

sentences.en: It's easy for a rich man to tell you to save your money.
sentences.zh: 一个有钱人劝你存钱很容易。

sentences.en: He got money.
sentences.zh: 因为他有钱。

sentences.en: How can a rich man tell a poor man what's going on, what life is about?
sentences.zh: 一个有钱人怎么能告诉穷人什么是现实，生活是怎么一回事呢？

sentences.en: It's got to be someone that knows the avenues to go to someone that's black that's been through it.
sentences.zh: 那必须是一个知道该走什么途径的人，一个经历过这一切的黑人。

sentences.en: You know, you got, you got, and then, you know, that's, that's his ticket.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你懂的，然后，你知道的，那是，那是他的通行证。

sentences.en: That's his motivation there to show you what, how it can be done.
sentences.zh: 那是他的动力，向你展示事情应该、可以如何完成。

sentences.en: Giving students the feeling that they are understood by their teachers.
sentences.zh: 让学生感受到他们被老师理解。

sentences.en: Who can say this is a bad idea?
sentences.zh: 谁能说这是一个坏主意呢？

sentences.en: But if you zoom out, putting this idea into practice runs into all sorts of problems related to history, politics, and optics.
sentences.zh: 但如果你把视野放大，将这个想法付诸实践会遇到各种各样与历史、政治和公众形象相关的问题。

sentences.en: I asked Constance Lindsay about this.
sentences.zh: 我向康斯坦斯·林赛询问了这件事。

sentences.en: Let's say you're the principal of a school.
sentences.zh: 假设你是一所学校的校长。

sentences.en: And you have one black teacher in second grade.
sentences.zh: 而你二年级只有一个黑人老师。

sentences.en: And you have, let's say, 15 black students spread across five sections of second grade.
sentences.zh: 假设你有15名黑人学生，分布在二年级的五个班里。

sentences.en: Would you assign all those 15 students to the black teacher?
sentences.zh: 你会把这15名学生全部分配给这个黑人老师吗？

sentences.en: I probably would not do that.
sentences.zh: 我可能不会这么做。

sentences.en: If I had students that in that particular set of 15 that were particularly disadvantaged, I might.
sentences.zh: 如果这15个人当中有些学生处境特别不利，我可能会。

sentences.en: I might also explore ways in which teachers could co-teach so that, you know, all of those 15 students would have the opportunity to interact with that teacher.
sentences.zh: 我也可能会探索老师共同授课的方式，这样，你知道的，所有这15名学生都有机会与那位老师互动。

sentences.en: But I definitely wouldn't advocate sort of segregating them into one class.
sentences.zh: 但我绝对不会主张把他们隔离到一个班里。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: That's what your data show works.
sentences.zh: 你的数据表明这样是有效的。

sentences.en: That is what the data show that works.
sentences.zh: 数据确实表明这样有效。

sentences.en: But I think we agreed that segregation is bad.
sentences.zh: 但我想我们都同意隔离是不好的。

sentences.en: But I think this is what makes the paper really, really tricky,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得这正是这篇论文非常非常棘手的地方，

sentences.en: which is it's actually suggesting that something that we thought was a good thing might have an outcome that is not such a good thing.
sentences.zh: 也就是它实际上表明，我们曾以为是件好事的事情，可能会带来并非那么美好的结果。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So I guess if you held a gun to my head and you said I had to pick between segregating students and, you know, making sure that students had a black teacher,
sentences.zh: 所以我想，如果你把枪抵在我头上，逼我在隔离学生和确保学生能有一位黑人老师之间做出选择，

sentences.en: I would pick that they had a black teacher.
sentences.zh: 我会选择让他们有一位黑人老师。

sentences.en: So you actually would put the students in the same class then?
sentences.zh: 所以你实际上还是会把学生分到同一个班里？

sentences.en: If you said I had to.
sentences.zh: 如果你非要我选的话。

sentences.en: No, I guess what I'm asking you is not so much whether I have to, but, you know, if you looked at the data and said that you are improving the odds of students by 10, 15,
sentences.zh: 不，我想我问你的与其说是我是否必须这样做，不如说是，你知道的，如果你看到数据说你将学生的胜算提高了10%、15%，

sentences.en: maybe 20 percent, and you did not do that thing that could improve their odds by 10, 15, 20 percent, I mean, that is immoral.
sentences.zh: 甚至是20%，而你却没有采取那种能将他们的胜算提高10%、15%、20%的措施，我的意思是，这太不道德了。

sentences.en: You could say that.
sentences.zh: 你可以这么说。

sentences.en: You could say that.
sentences.zh: 你可以这么说。

sentences.en: I mean, if I were a parent of a black boy and there was one black male teacher in the school, I would go tell the principal to assign my child to him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我是一个黑人男孩的家长，学校里只有一个黑人男老师，我会去告诉校长把我的孩子分到他的班里。

sentences.en: There is some evidence the race-matching effects we see in medicine and education also show up in other spheres.
sentences.zh: 有一些证据表明，我们在医学和教育领域看到的种族匹配效应也会出现在其他领域。

sentences.en: At Temple University, Derek Avery and his colleagues found that customers at a retail store who interacted with sales agents of the same race had higher levels of satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 在天普大学，德里克·艾弗里和他的同事发现，在零售店里，与同种族销售人员互动的顾客满意度更高。

sentences.en: This was especially true in areas where racial minorities were a larger share of the customer base.
sentences.zh: 在少数族裔占顾客群体比例更大的地区，这一点尤其明显。

sentences.en: Columbia University's Raymond Fissman found in a study conducted in India that ethnic and religious matching between bankers and customers increased the likelihood of loans being repaid.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚大学的雷蒙德·菲斯曼在印度进行的一项研究中发现，银行家与客户之间的民族和宗教匹配增加了贷款偿还的可能性。

sentences.en: It also lowered the cost of loans because banks perceived there was a lower risk in lending money.
sentences.zh: 它还降低了贷款成本，因为银行认为放贷风险较小。

sentences.en: Other workers observed that gender can act in similar ways to racial or religious identification.
sentences.zh: 其他研究人员观察到，性别也可以起到类似于种族或宗教身份认同的作用。

sentences.en: Brad Greenwood at the University of Minnesota found that more women in Florida survived a heart attack when their doctor was a woman rather than a man.
sentences.zh: 明尼苏达大学的布拉德·格林wood发现，在佛罗里达州，当主治医生是女医生而不是男医生时，更多的女性心脏病发作幸存下来。

sentences.en: At the University of Massachusetts,
sentences.zh: 在马萨诸塞大学，

sentences.en: social psychologist Nilanjana Dasgupta has found that female students in calculus classes were more engaged in the subject when they had a female professor rather than a male professor.
sentences.zh: 社会心理学家尼兰贾娜·达斯古普塔发现，微积分课堂上的女生，如果授课的是女教授而不是男教授，会更多地投入到学科中。

sentences.en: Just having a female professor ends up making women feel they'll do better in the class.
sentences.zh: 仅仅拥有一位女教授，就能让女性觉得她们在这门课上会表现得更好。

sentences.en: Making them feel more confident, making them feel that they care more about math than when the same course material, same exam, same syllabus is taught by a male professor.
sentences.zh: 这会让他们感到更自信，觉得她们比由男教授讲授相同课程材料、相同考试、相同教学大纲时更关心数学。

sentences.en: This is important because calculus is a gateway class to degrees and careers in math and science where women are currently underrepresented.
sentences.zh: 这很重要，因为微积分是通往数学和科学领域学位及职业的敲门砖，而目前女性在这些领域的代表性仍然不足。

sentences.en: There are three lessons from all these examples.
sentences.zh: 从所有这些例子中可以总结出三个教训。

sentences.en: The first is that we really need doctors and teachers and loan officers and store clerks from different races and different backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们确实需要来自不同种族、不同背景的医生、老师、信贷员和店员。

sentences.en: It can have tangible and measurable outcomes.
sentences.zh: 这能产生切实且可衡量的结果。

sentences.en: The second lesson is that if we want to be understood by people who are different from us in some way, it's going to take work.
sentences.zh: 第二个教训是，如果我们想被与我们在某些方面不同的人理解，这需要付出努力。

sentences.en: You can't just assume that your job begins and ends with teaching a course or diagnosing a patient.
sentences.zh: 你不能仅仅认为你的工作就是教一门课或诊断一个病人，这就结束了。

sentences.en: You have to make a connection with the human being across from you.
sentences.zh: 你必须与你面前的人建立联系。

sentences.en: The final lesson has to do with the seemingly contradictory effects of diversity.
sentences.zh: 最后一个教训与多元化看似矛盾的影响有关。

sentences.en: In an earlier episode of Hidden Brain, The Edge Effect, we talked about how diversity boosts creativity and innovation.
sentences.zh: 在《隐藏的大脑》之前的一期节目《边缘效应》中，我们探讨了多元化如何促进创造力和创新。

sentences.en: By contrast, here we've seen how connecting with people who are like us can produce better outcomes.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，在这里我们看到了与我们相似的人建立联系如何能产生更好的结果。

sentences.en: One explanation for this contradiction lies in what you are trying to achieve.
sentences.zh: 对这种矛盾的一种解释在于你试图实现的目标。

sentences.en: If you want novelty and creativity, those flourish from bringing together different perspectives.
sentences.zh: 如果你想要新意和创造力，这些会从汇聚不同的观点中蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: But if you want trust and communication, those come easier when we have things in common.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想要信任和沟通，当我们有共同点时，这些就更容易实现。
